description: Figures of the known F3A schedules P25, F25, P27, F27 and A27 that are the same as a catalogue entry (task S2, docs/plans/f3a-catalogue-continuation.md). Used by tests/test_f3a_known_parity.py.
how_matched: The known schedules carry no rulebook words. Each known figure was decoded from its elements into the words in `words` (loop angles, roll amounts with their stops and directions, spins, lines, entry attitude) and matched to the rulebook text by the figure's words: same kind and order of elements, same loop angles and signs, same roll amounts and stops, same entry attitude. The known schedule's heights, padding, K and line lengths were not part of the match; they are compared by the test and any difference is recorded. Candidates were found with a script comparing element sequences, then each match was confirmed against the rulebook text.

decisions.intended: the catalogue behaviour is deliberate and documented
decisions.schedule-specific: the known schedule sets this for its own figure (K, heights, padding); no catalogue change
decisions.open: needs a decision from the owner
